response.explanation: A 0.5% loss of global supply, under standard short-run demand inelasticity (Ed = -0.15), implies roughly a 3.3% price increase.

ev_feasibility.explanation: A 0.5% loss of global crude supply removes about 516,500 barrels/day. Over 1.0 year(s), that's 3,676,188,750 gallons of gasoline that won't get refined -- roughly the annual fuel needs of 7,352,378 gasoline vehicles. Replacing that many vehicles with EVs instead would need about 58,819 tonnes of lithium (as LCE) -- about 3.8% of the world's annual lithium production.
